Important communique

Migration of the Online Search website to a new domain

Please take note of the following important dates and changes:
  • Effective June 18, 2026: This website will officially move to its new address:
    https://onlinesearch.mns.global. You can begin using the new URL from this date.
  • Effective July 31, 2026: The current (old) URL will be permanently decommissioned and will no longer be accessible.

Note:
If you access this platform via any saved links or corporate bookmarks, please update them to the new URL
(https://onlinesearch.mns.global) before July 31st.
